board: LM393 photosensitive LDR light sensor module, common blue 3-pin clone board (VCC, GND, DO)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico in its first run. The part is modelled as a digital-sensor with an active-LOW DO: the common board pulls DO low in bright light (DO LED lit) and the LM393 output is open-collector with a pull-up to VCC on the board. The driver lets you flip the polarity for reversed boards.
